rationales: A matrix is an arrangement of values, not the usual graphical representation of an algorithm.
A graph shows relationships between nodes but is not the standard algorithm diagram.
A flowchart graphically represents the steps and decisions of an algorithm.
A solution is an answer to a problem, not a graphical representation.
Checking is not the first step; the problem must first be understood.
Testing is generally done after a solution has been developed.
Analyzing the problem is the first step before solving it.
Output is produced after processing, not before problem solving.
The symbol ∨ represents the OR operator.
The symbol ¬ represents NOT, not OR.
The plus sign is not the standard logical OR symbol here.
The symbol ∧ represents AND, not OR.
This is a declarative statement that can be judged true or false, so it is a Boolean proposition.
It is not a categorical proposition that classifies subjects into categories.
It expresses no moral judgment or principle.
“Good proposition” is not the relevant logical category.
Text may be communicated over a network, but it is not the general function described.
Numbers may be transmitted, but they are not the general function described.
Networks facilitate communication and sharing among connected devices.
Area is not something that networks facilitate among connected devices.
An eight-character password is a recommended minimum length in basic password guidance.
Avoiding the username helps make a password harder to guess.
Including uppercase letters can improve password strength.
Using only your name makes a password easy to guess and is not a good password characteristic.
The body tag uses the attribute `background`, not `bg`, to specify a background image.
The `background` attribute is the legacy body-tag attribute used to set a webpage background image.
`bgimage` is not the relevant body-tag attribute.
`backimage` is not the relevant body-tag attribute.
IPv4 addresses are not 29 bits long.
IPv4 addresses are not 30 bits long.
IPv4 addresses are not 31 bits long.
An IPv4 address consists of 32 binary bits.
The terminal symbol marks the start or end of a flowchart.
A connector links separated parts of a flowchart.
A process symbol represents an operation or instruction.
A decision symbol represents a branch based on a condition.
A random error is not the error category for an algorithm that runs but gives the wrong result.
A logical error allows the algorithm to run but causes it to produce an incorrect result.
A syntax error violates the programming language's rules and prevents correct execution.
A runtime error occurs while a program is running, rather than describing an algorithm that runs with incorrect results.
Base 16 is used by the hexadecimal number system.
Base 10 is used by the decimal number system.
Base 8 is used by the octal number system.
The binary number system uses base 2.
HTML provides more than four heading levels.
HTML provides more than five heading levels.
HTML has six heading levels, from h1 to h6.
HTML does not have eight standard heading levels.
The associative law changes grouping, not the order of propositions.
The distributive law relates AND and OR operations across grouped propositions.
The commutative law says the order of propositions does not affect the result.
The identity law describes the effect of combining a proposition with an identity value.
A patent can protect an invention or idea that meets the legal requirements for patentability.
Copyright law protects original expressions of ideas, rather than ideas themselves.
A trade secret protects confidential business information, not an idea through formal registration.
Piracy is unauthorized copying or use, not a way to protect an idea.
A channel is a communication medium, not the destination network described.
Routing forwards data between devices or networks, including different networks.
A path is the route data takes, but the sentence refers to different networks.
An area is not the usual networking term for the destination of routed data.
